title: Your body is a public resume of your *private habits*

label: YOUR WAIST
head: Shows what you eat after 9PM
sub: The midnight fridge trips end up on your belt.

label: YOUR EYES
head: Show how many hours you sleep
sub: Eye bags are a sleep log you can't delete.

label: YOUR POSTURE
head: Shows your screen time
sub: 5 hours a day hunched over a screen rounds your shoulders.

label: YOUR ARMS
head: Show if you train without motivation
sub: Muscle is built on the Tuesdays you didn't feel like it.

text: Your physique isn't your worth. It's *proof you keep promises* to yourself.
